quantize_model_int8: quantize a model checkpoint to int8 weight-only symmetric per-channel quantization and save weights
quantize_model_int4: quantize a model checkpoint to int4 weight-only affine per-channel groupwise quantization with a given groupsize
quantize_model_int4_gptq: quantize a model checkpoint to int4 using GPTQ with calibration tasks and configurable blocksize
run_quantize_cli: run the quantize CLI to quantize a model checkpoint with int8, int4, or int4-gptq mode
review_WeightOnlyInt4Linear: review the WeightOnlyInt4Linear module that performs int4 groupwise quantized linear forward passes
